ruleset.name: Apex Best Practices Rules
ruleset.description: Custom rules for Apex best practices (modifiers, test classes, code quality)

rule.name: TestClassIsParallel
rule.message: Test classes must have @IsTest(IsParallel=true) annotation to enable parallel test execution
rule.description:
Test classes must include IsParallel=true in their @IsTest annotation to explicitly enable parallel test execution. While tests run in parallel by default in Salesforce, explicitly setting IsParallel=true ensures parallel execution even if organization settings change, improving test performance by allowing tests to run concurrently, reducing overall test execution time and improving developer productivity.
Test classes that use restricted operations are exempt from this requirement, as they cannot run in parallel anyway. Restricted operations include: - Using @IsTest(seeAllData=true) - Tests with seeAllData=true cannot run in parallel due to data contention issues - Calling Test.getStandardPricebookId() - Calling System.schedule() or System.enqueueJob() - Inserting ContentNote SObjects - Creating User or GroupMember SObjects - Using SObjects that can't be used together in DML operations
Version: 2.1.0
